findings.claim: The golden does not cover M1–M16 for every committed fixture. Whole statements are captured only when a test calls metrics.compute. The two-credit Monzo invoice fixture is represented only by individual categorisation rows, so rebuilding the golden repeats the omission.
findings.repro: Trace tests/test_import_monzo.py:136–147. It imports and categorises the £4,800 Oakfield and £900 Acme credits without calling metrics.compute. Decompress tests/golden/p7_v1_baseline.json.gz and search for INV1042 and INVOICE2210. Both occur in the lines array only, with no statement-level metric baseline for that fixture.
